boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Butler University
boards.description: Ten under-21 food runs spanning Butler’s campus, nearby north-side corridors, and farther Indianapolis options with current official late-hour evidence.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Pizza ATM
cards.subtitle: Residential College, Butler University
cards.notes: Head to Midtown Provisions for an automated hot-food option when staffed campus counters have already closed.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock automated food stop inside Butler’s Residential College.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that the Pizza ATM in Midtown Provisions operates 24/7 and sells house-made pizzas, pretzel bites, and cookies.
cards.access_notes: The Pizza ATM operates 24/7; building access or academic-break conditions may affect availability.

cards.title: Order Late-Night Bites at Midtown
cards.subtitle: Residential College, Butler University
cards.notes: Order through Boost before midnight on a weekday; the late menu is separate from Midtown’s regular service.
cards.short_summary: Butler’s staffed weekday late-food counter runs through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Midtown Provisions’ Late-Night Bites service from 8:00 PM to midnight Monday through Friday, ordered through the Boost app.
cards.access_notes: Late-Night Bites runs Monday–Friday, 8:00 PM–midnight, and requires ordering through the Boost app.

cards.title: Catch A-Town Market Before Ten
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Atherton Union
cards.notes: Stop before the posted 10:00 PM weekday or Sunday close for made-to-order food, snacks, or microwaveable options.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus market that remains open later than Butler’s main dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists A-Town Market in Atherton Union as open until 10:00 PM Monday through Friday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 9:00 AM–10:00 PM Monday–Friday and 10:00 AM–10:00 PM Sunday; Saturday closes at 4:00 PM.

cards.entity_name: Pizza King | Meridian Kessler | Broad Ripple
cards.title: Make a Broad Ripple Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 5380 N College Avenue
cards.notes: Use this north-side stop for a counter-service pizza run, noting the slightly later Friday and Saturday close.
cards.short_summary: A named Broad Ripple pizza shop serving until nearly midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza King’s official Broad Ripple page lists an 11:00 PM close Sunday through Thursday and an 11:45 PM close Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11:45 PM Friday–Saturday, according to the restaurant’s official page.

cards.title: Use the All-Night Keystone Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 5509 N Keystone Avenue
cards.notes: Check the location page before leaving and confirm whether counter, pickup, or drive-through service fits your trip.
cards.short_summary: A north-side fast-food location whose official schedule spans the full day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-through hours from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are listed as 4:00 AM–3:59 AM daily, effectively continuous service.

cards.title: Head South for a 3 A.M. Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 2245 N Meridian Street
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to verify same-night service, especially if you need an option south of campus.
cards.short_summary: A Meridian Street fast-food run with service listed into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Indianapolis location listing identifies the 2245 N Meridian Street restaurant and lists it as open until 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official Wendy’s Indianapolis listing shows this location open until 3:00 AM; verify the available service channel before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 6165 N Keystone Avenue
cards.title: Try the 24-Hour Keystone Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 6165 N Keystone Avenue
cards.notes: Confirm the ordering channel before traveling; the official page currently shows continuous dine-in and drive-through hours.
cards.short_summary: A north-side Taco Bell officially displaying round-the-clock hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 6165 N Keystone Avenue lists both drive-through and dine-in hours as midnight to midnight every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Indianapolis, IN – 6165 N Keystone Ave.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-through and dine-in service as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM daily; reconfirm before departure.

cards.title: Use the Late Dine-In on 38th Street
cards.subtitle: 2809 E 38th Street
cards.notes: Choose this location when indoor service matters; its posted dine-in close extends beyond many nearby restaurant counters.
cards.short_summary: An east-side Taco Bell with indoor service listed until 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-through service until 4:00 AM daily and dine-in service until 2:00 AM at 2809 E 38th Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Indianapolis, IN – 2809 East 38th Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is posted until 4:00 AM daily; the official page displays dine-in hours of 10:00 AM–2:00 AM.

cards.title: Take the Michigan Road Diner Route
cards.subtitle: 8640 Michigan Road
cards.notes: Save this longer northwestern run for nights when a seated diner-style menu matters more than staying close to campus.
cards.short_summary: A diner-style option serving until 2:00 AM on three nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak ’n Shake’s official location page lists midnight closing Monday through Thursday and 2:00 AM closing Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday–Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday–Sunday, according to the official location page.

cards.entity_name: Steak ’n Shake at 101 W Maryland Street
cards.title: Pair Downtown Plans With Steak ’n Shake
cards.subtitle: 101 W Maryland Street
cards.notes: Use this downtown option after an evening event, allowing extra travel time between central Indianapolis and Butler’s campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant with a later Friday and Saturday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak ’n Shake’s official location page lists midnight closing Sunday through Thursday and 2:00 AM closing Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday, according to the official location page.

warnings: Hours can change during university breaks, holidays, or operational disruptions; verify the direct source before departure.
Some off-campus choices require driving or another safe transportation plan from Butler University.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost ways to gather on or near Butler’s campus, including public gardens, arts, astronomy, athletics, gaming, fitness, and bikeshare.

cards.title: Walk the Native Garden Beds
cards.subtitle: A free public garden on Butler’s campus
cards.notes: Meet by the garden entrance, follow the paths around all 13 native beds, and leave time to pause near the pond and carillon.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed campus walk through restored native plantings and established garden landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that Holcomb Gardens has been free and open to the public since 1928 and serves as a gathering and botanical-learning space.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; stay on established paths and check campus notices before visiting.

cards.title: Look Through the 38-Inch Telescope
cards.subtitle: Weather-dependent telescope viewing without planetarium admission
cards.notes: Check the public-tour schedule and forecast, then join the telescope portion only; expect 66 stairs unless ground-level viewing is arranged.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission look through Indiana’s largest telescope when weather permits.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that viewing through the Holcomb Observatory telescope is always free, weather permitting; planetarium shows charge admission.
cards.access_notes: Telescope viewing is free and weather dependent. The telescope room requires 66 stairs; contact the observatory ahead for ground-level viewing.

cards.entity_name: Indiana Pacers Bikeshare at Butler University
cards.title: Take a Butler Bikeshare Loop
cards.subtitle: Free rides for eligible Butler pass holders
cards.notes: Activate the Butler pass before meeting, choose a short trail-connected loop, and return every bike securely to an available station.
cards.short_summary: A pass-based group ride from one of Butler’s campus bikeshare stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that students, faculty, and staff with an active Butler email are eligible to ride Pacers Bikeshare free through the university pass.
cards.source_title: Indiana Pacers Bikeshare at Butler University
cards.access_notes: Requires an active Butler email, application, promo code, and BCycle app activation. Visitors without an eligible free pass must pay.

cards.title: Set Up a Multiplayer Game Session
cards.subtitle: LAN, console, and board games for current Butler students
cards.notes: Confirm open-play hours, bring your Butler ID, and pick one shared game before arrival so the group can start together.
cards.short_summary: A student-only gaming meetup using the Esports Park’s included equipment and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Esports Park membership as free for current Butler students and says membership includes unlimited LAN, console-cart, and board-game access during operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Free for current Butler students during operating hours; summer camps or other programming may close the facility. Community access is paid.

cards.title: Plan a Recreation-Center Workout
cards.subtitle: Equipment and recreation access through student membership
cards.notes: Agree on a low-pressure workout, meet inside the HRC, and choose equipment or an activity that works for everyone’s comfort level.
cards.short_summary: An active student hang using the recreation membership included for eligible Butler students.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that students receive a full Health and Recreation Complex membership with access to its equipment, programs, and services.
cards.access_notes: Limited to eligible Butler students with HRC access. Bring a Butler ID and verify current facility hours before meeting.

cards.title: Watch a Butler Baseball Game
cards.subtitle: A ticket-free varsity event open to everyone
cards.notes: Choose a home date from the athletics schedule, meet before first pitch, and bring weather-appropriate layers for an outdoor game.
cards.short_summary: A casual group outing to a Butler baseball game without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies baseball among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Verify the current home schedule and weather before attending.

cards.title: Catch a Butler Softball Game
cards.subtitle: No-ticket athletics for students and the public
cards.notes: Pick a home matchup, meet near the spectator entrance, and check for weather-driven schedule changes before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor spectator hang centered on a free Butler softball matchup.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies softball among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Confirm the home schedule because outdoor games may change with weather.

cards.title: Cheer at a Butler Swim Meet
cards.subtitle: A no-ticket collegiate meet open to the public
cards.notes: Check the meet venue and start time, arrive before the first event, and use posted spectator areas throughout the competition.
cards.short_summary: An indoor athletics meetup with multiple races to watch together.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies swimming among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Verify the current meet venue and spectator-access instructions.

cards.title: Follow a Butler Tennis Match
cards.subtitle: Free varsity competition with no ticket required
cards.notes: Select a home match, check whether play is indoors or outdoors, and settle near one court before the opening serve.
cards.short_summary: A flexible spectator outing where the group can follow several courts of play.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies tennis among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Check the athletics schedule for the current venue and any weather relocation.

cards.title: Browse Six Rotating Galleries
cards.subtitle: A free indoor art outing north of Butler
cards.notes: Meet in the Michael Graves-designed building, browse the rotating galleries together, and finish with quiet work time in the library.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery visit with indoor space for conversation, viewing, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Indianapolis Art Center states that its campus is always free, invites visitors to explore its galleries and Ruth Lilly Library, and charges no admission.
cards.access_notes: The indoor campus and galleries are free and open seven days a week. ARTSPARK is separately closed for renovation until Fall 2026.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along distinct corridors in Butler’s practical Indianapolis orbit, each selected for one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Courts and a Splash Pad at Tarkington Park
cards.subtitle: West 40th Street corridor
cards.notes: Head east on the 40th Street corridor for tennis, basketball, the multi-use field, covered shelter, splash pad, and public restrooms.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-focused stop on 40th Street with several ways to get moving outdoors.
cards.evidence_claim: Indy Parks lists Tarkington Park at 45 W 40th St with tennis and basketball courts, a multi-use field, covered shelter, splash pad, and no entrance fee.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are dawn to dusk; Indy Parks lists no entrance fee.

cards.title: Art and Nature Meet at Newfields
cards.subtitle: Michigan Road at West 38th Street
cards.notes: Follow the Michigan Road corridor to pair museum galleries with gardens and more than 100 acres of woodland on one documented campus.
cards.short_summary: One Michigan Road destination combines indoor art, cultivated gardens, and wooded landscapes.
cards.evidence_claim: Newfields identifies its address as 4000 Michigan Road and describes galleries surrounded by gardens, water features, and more than 100 acres of woodland.
cards.access_notes: Museum and Garden admission is ticketed; the art-and-nature park operates dawn to dusk. Check current ticket availability before leaving.

cards.title: Take a Self-Guided History Walk
cards.subtitle: West 38th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 38th Street entrance, then download a tree, bicentennial, or racing-legends route and explore the historic grounds respectfully.
cards.short_summary: Downloadable routes turn Crown Hill’s grounds into a focused local-history excursion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crown Hill Foundation lists the cemetery at 700 West 38th Street and offers downloadable Tree Map, Bicentennial Tour, and Racing Legends self-guided resources.
cards.source_title: Tours & Events in Indianapolis | Crown Hill Foundation
cards.access_notes: Grounds may be enjoyed independently; observe posted cemetery hours and yield to services. Some organized tours may require registration or payment.

cards.title: Try a Pennsylvania-Style Hoagie
cards.subtitle: Boulevard Place corridor near West 42nd Street
cards.notes: Walk the Boulevard Place corridor when you want a meal built around South Jersey rolls, Philadelphia meats and Pennsylvania Dutch specialties.
cards.short_summary: This nearby sandwich shop centers its menu on food traditions from southeastern Pennsylvania.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoagies & Hops says it uses bread from South Jersey and meats, pickles, and chips from Philadelphia and Pennsylvania Dutch country.
cards.access_notes: A food purchase is required. Confirm current service hours and the Boulevard Place entrance directly with the business.

cards.title: Make 49th and Penn a Breakfast Stop
cards.subtitle: East 49th Street and Pennsylvania Street
cards.notes: Take the Pennsylvania Street corridor to the 49th Street corner for made-to-order omelets, soups, salads, sandwiches, coffee, or dessert.
cards.short_summary: The corner’s daytime café menu spans breakfast plates and lighter lunch options.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Patachou states that its cafés serve made-to-order omelets, salads, soups, sandwiches, desserts, and coffee; its location materials identify the 49th-and-Penn café.
cards.source_title: About | Cafe Patachou in IN and KY
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required. Check the restaurant’s current location page for same-day hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse Records at LUNA music
cards.subtitle: North College Avenue at East 52nd Street
cards.notes: Continue along College Avenue to browse the independent record shop, using its posted daily schedule to time a daytime stop.
cards.short_summary: A clearly marked College Avenue storefront gives music browsing a specific destination.
cards.evidence_claim: LUNA music’s official contact page places the shop at 5202 N College Ave and lists operating hours seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Contact | LUNA music | Jamming in Indianapolis, IN since '94
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–6 p.m.; merchandise requires purchase.

cards.title: Choose the Bakery-and-Deli Block
cards.subtitle: North Illinois Street at West 56th Street
cards.notes: Follow Illinois Street north for a daytime bakery, café and deli stop whose scratch-kitchen history in Butler-Tarkington dates to 1979.
cards.short_summary: A long-running neighborhood storefront combines bakery cases, café seating, and deli fare.
cards.evidence_claim: The business identifies itself as a bakery, café, and scratch kitchen at 5550 N Illinois St and says it has operated in Butler-Tarkington since 1979.
cards.source_title: Our Story — Scratch Kitchen Since 1979 | Illinois Street Food Emporium
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required. The official site lists daytime hours Monday through Saturday and closure on Sunday.

cards.title: Use 46th Street for a Flexible Café Stop
cards.subtitle: East 46th Street at Cornell Avenue
cards.notes: Head east along 46th Street when you need a café with morning openings and day-dependent afternoon or evening closing times.
cards.short_summary: GoldLeaf’s varied weekly schedule makes this a useful coffee-and-food waypoint east of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: GoldLeaf’s official site places the café at 1901 E 46th St and publishes opening and closing times for every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required. The posted schedule varies by day, so check the official page before traveling east.

cards.title: See Free Galleries at the Indy Art Center
cards.subtitle: East 67th Street beside the Monon Trail
cards.notes: Take the 67th Street corridor to explore free indoor galleries and the Michael Graves-designed building while ARTSPARK is under renovation.
cards.short_summary: The Art Center currently offers a no-admission indoor art stop beside the Monon Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Indy Art Center says its campus and galleries are free, identifies its building as Michael Graves-designed, and lists the address as 820 E 67th St.
cards.access_notes: The campus and galleries have no admission charge. ARTSPARK is closed for renovation with reopening projected for fall 2026.

cards.title: Follow Broad Ripple Avenue to the White River
cards.subtitle: Broad Ripple Avenue east of the Monon Trail
cards.notes: Use Broad Ripple Avenue for a park outing with river views, walking paths, outdoor courts and the wooded trails of the 10 Acre Woods.
cards.short_summary: The avenue ends at a named riverfront park with paths, courts, woods, and recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Indy Parks locates Broad Ripple Park at 1500 Broad Ripple Ave and documents White River views, walking trails, outdoor courts, and the 10 Acre Woods.
cards.source_title: Broad Ripple Park - Indy Parks & Recreation
cards.access_notes: Park grounds are open dawn to dusk. Pool use, classes, or other programmed facilities may have separate fees or schedules.
